name: Technology Consultant
target: Consulting and solution-engineering roles where delivery outranks stack.

content.summary: Technology consultant who scopes AI programmes and then delivers them. Authored the AI scope and feasibility assessment for the Prime Minister Internship Scheme — a 144 person-month programme for the Ministry of Corporate Affairs — and personally built five platforms now running in government production, including a citizen-facing assistant live on kheloindia.gov.in and a drafting system piloted in a live 2026 Parliament session. Works the full arc: stakeholder scoping, feasibility and estimation, solution architecture, delivery and cost engineering. National-level athlete and 7x hackathon placer.

skills.label: Technical Environment
items: Azure (App Service, Managed Redis, Service Bus)

experience.employer: EY  (deployed to National e-Governance Division, MeitY)
experience.context: Technology and AI advisory for Government of India digital programmes — Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, and Sports Authority of India.

blocks.title: Prime Minister Internship Scheme — AI programme scoping · Ministry of Corporate Affairs

bullets.text: Authored the 12,000-word AI Scope Document (14 sections, 24 tables, graded source register) and a 14-page Feasibility Assessment rating 22 interventions on a four-tier rubric — consolidating 19 use cases into 8 features on 6 shared building blocks and reconciling a 144 person-month estimate the source note had left unexplained.

Designed the delivery model: five phases governed by five data gates, a three-tier data-access contingency so delivery proceeds without portal source code, an equity-preservation constraint with rollback triggers, and ten decisions escalated to the Ministry — four of them Phase-1 blocking.
Benchmarked 13 international youth-employment programmes tiered by comparability, and set falsifiable targets against dated baselines (offer-to-join 10% → 13–14%; completion of joiners 46% → 60%).

blocks.title: PQ-Bot — Parliamentary Question drafting platform · MYAS / Sports Authority of India

bullets.text: Sole engineer on a ~60,000-LOC AWS Bedrock platform piloted during the 2026 Parliament monsoon session, grounding official replies in 702 prior tabled Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha answers with per-sentence citations.

Delivered against NeGD SOP, ISO 27001 and CMMI L3 targets under a spec-driven SDLC: 312 tests green, SAST closed at zero critical findings, and a GIGW / WCAG 2.2 AA pre-audit with 15 of 23 findings remediated.

blocks.title: Khelo India Knowledge Assistant — live in production on kheloindia.gov.in

bullets.text: Architected and shipped a citizen-facing multilingual assistant (12 languages, 206 documents) and cut run-rate ~60% — ₹9.4L to ₹3.5L per month, ~₹1.35 per query — by re-architecting the stack, while raising judged answer correctness to 3.9 / 4 on a 213-case evaluation bank.

blocks.title: Scout — internal bid discovery platform · EY

bullets.text: Built a crawler and classification service over public procurement portals (GeM, CPPP) with a five-parameter weighted scoring model to qualify tenders against practice fit, plus 31 architecture decision records — delivered alongside the engagement's Senior Manager and Director.

blocks.title: MYAS Task Tracker & Khelo India Expenditure Tracker — internal platforms, in production

bullets.text: Authored the architecture, HLD/LLD and deployment design for both and ran them to production on AWS; the expenditure platform tracks ₹924 Cr of scheme budget across 14 regional centres.
